lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's thirty-six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 36? Nope!

lines.text: Five identical rectangles make one big rectangle, with a perimeter of sixty-six.
lines.caption: 5 identical rectangles make one big rectangle, with a perimeter of 66.

lines.text: What's the area of one small rectangle?
lines.caption: What's the area of one small rectangle?

lines.text: Two long sides on top match three short sides below.
lines.caption: 2 long sides on top match 3 short sides below.

lines.text: So say short is two blocks, and long is three. The big one is six by five!
lines.caption: So say short is 2 blocks, and long is 3. The big one is 6 by 5!

lines.text: Walk around: twenty-two blocks make sixty-six. One block is three!
lines.caption: Walk around: 22 blocks make 66. One block is 3!

lines.text: Short is six, long is nine. The area is fifty-four!
lines.caption: Short is 6, long is 9. The area is 54!

lines.text: Thirty-six was the trap. It squares the short side.
lines.caption: 36 was the trap. It squares the short side.

lines.text: Did you get fifty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 54? Tell me below!
